newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs tumble limit on cash price concerns.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs tumble limit on cash price concerns.

text.p: Growing concern over next week's cash hog and pork markets added to selling pressure in hog futures, triggering sell stops and sparking limit losses of 2.000 cents in October and December, traders said.
October fell the limit to 71.025 and December limit down to 67.700 cents. Other months were 1.750 to 0.125 cents lower.
Ideas that cash hog markets would definitely be lower next week increased when projections on the cash loin market turned lower. Loin prices could fall next week, they said.
